name: What factors influence the cost of installing drywall in a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of installing drywall in a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen drywall installation depends primarily on the square footage, ceiling height, and the extent of demolition or framing adjustments required. Smaller repair patches or single-wall installations cost significantly less than hanging and finishing an entire gutted room. Other pricing factors include cutting around dense configurations of plumbing, range hoods, and electrical boxes, as well as the chosen finish level. At HH Remodeling LLC, Abraham Becerra provides straightforward project estimates that detail drywall hanging, taping, floating, and prep work alongside trades like framing and painting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on total room square footage, ceiling height, framing repairs, the number of rough-in cutouts for utilities, and the level of finish requested.
